title: crosslabel: cross-label moments and spatial estimators for stochastically multiplexed localization microscopy

creators.name: Variankaval, Rohan
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Johns Hopkins University

description: Crosslabel implements a connected three-code contrast and spatial interval for checking oligomer libraries in permanently coded localization microscopy. This release contains the Python package and wheel, simulation generators, all benchmark and sensitivity results, reproduction scripts, and manuscript figure sources. Analyses include marked-pair and SPINNA comparisons, connected triple correlation with tiled and shared nested intervals, retention and field-area sensitivity, runtime measurements, and Nup96 and CD20 reanalyses. Code is MIT licensed; experimental observations retain the source terms documented in DATA.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
